notes: וָמֵת is rendered by the resultative *to death* inside the preceding clause, so its waw has no connective written for it and is unrepresented; the alternative of leaving *to death* to the verb סָקַל would leave a written verb unaligned against rule 2.
מֵעַל is fused under rule 30 and headed on the governing first morpheme under rule 23; the two מִן of the following clauses each take the whole *out of*, headed on *out*.
